title: Barbershop one-pager with booking button
brief: Client runs a two-chair barbershop. Needs one page: hours, address, price list, photo strip, and a booking button that opens his calendar. He has the photos on his phone and the logo as a screenshot — brother will need to clean the logo with the media FX clipper.
skills_note: Unlocks from: 02-real-life-minecraft (blocks) + wiki/Hustling pages (deploy). The logo cleanup is 03-media-fx-clipper rung 1.
handoff_note: Deliverable: deployed GitHub Pages URL + a HANDOFF.md the client can read (plain talk, no jargon) + ownership transfer docs in the wiki style.
